'''September 2000 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Leisure Hours Hobbies, Joliet, Illinois on 23 September 2000. [[Steve Kuperman]] won it. It is known from Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1267">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-joliet-illinois-9-23-2000d1267/ joliet-illinois-9-23-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-joliet-illinois-9-23-2000d1267/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Leisure Hours Hobbies, Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
